work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief XXVIII suspends Bishop Pasquale De Nicolais from governing Nusco, appoints Archbishop Marino of Salerno administrator and reserves a pension; LF4725 → LF4737 across provenance LF4728, mark LF4731 and running title LF4734; complete 15 May 1835 closing before XXIX LF4854. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF4671–4671; the source closing at LF4848–4851 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima quinta maii mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pon- tificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
